source: PINTO model zoo 426_YOLOX-Body-Head-Hand, nano, epoch 461, mAP 0.4428

input.name: input
input.resize: letterbox: keep the aspect ratio, pad bottom/right with 114
input.constraint: H and W must be multiples of 32

output.name: output
output.row: cx, cy, w, h (raw, grid-relative), objectness, p(body), p(head), p(hand)
output.decode: cx = (raw + grid_x) * stride; w = exp(raw_w) * stride; score = objectness * p(class); sigmoid already applied
output.nms: not included; apply it per class
